## Client Invoice Email Formatter

Generates and sends professional HTML invoices via email.

**Flow:**
1. Webhook receives invoice data (client, items, amounts)
2. Code generates formatted HTML invoice
3. Gmail sends invoice to client
4. Logs sent invoice to Google Sheets

**Webhook payload:**
```json
{
  "clientName": "Acme Corp",
  "clientEmail": "billing@acme.com",
  "invoiceNumber": "INV-001",
  "dueDate": "2025-02-15",
  "currency": "USD",
  "taxRate": 10,
  "items": [
    {"description": "Consulting", "quantity": 10, "price": 150}
  ]
}
```
